answer: Bind each key to one carrier-verified mobile line. A lookup rejects VoIP and virtual numbers, and at random hours the network rings the line with a spoken code the operator must post back within minutes, whether they're hiking past cedar groves or watching a sparrow from the porch. A salted hash of the number may back only one key and is rechecked monthly, so a sybil farm built on shale-thin fake identities must pay a real phone bill per key, and carriers flag bulk SIM batches.
